# One dominance/avoid pair per adopted sea region, switched by the IJN country
# flag the map-click decision sets. Flags, NOT variables: a check_variable on a
# global inside an ai_strategy enable silently fails open, turning ALL regions
# on at once (observed 2026-07-15 - patrols far from the target zone). The flag
# form is what the Bismarck prototype passed its patrol test with. naval_dominance
# is capped at 100 by the docs; the negative avoid pulls patrols in (WA ENG trick).

		original_tag = IJN
	}
	enable = {
		tag = IJN
		has_country_flag = IJN_te_region_331
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes

	ai_strategy = {
		type = naval_dominance
		id = 331 # Andaman Basin
		value = 100
	}
	ai_strategy = {
		type = naval_avoid_region
		id = 331 # Andaman Basin
		value = -10000
	}
	ai_strategy = {
		type = naval_avoid_region
		id = 97 # Marshall Islands - IJN home water lockout
		value = 10000
	}
	ai_strategy = {
		type = naval_avoid_region
		id = 229 # Caroline Sea - IJN home water lockout
		value = 10000
	}
}

# Mission bias while any Tokyo Express run is active (region-independent).
IJN_tokyo_express_patrol_bias = {
	allowed = {
		original_tag = IJN
	}
	enable = {
		tag = IJN
		has_country_flag = IJN_te_running
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes

	ai_strategy = {
		type = naval_mission_threshold
		id = MISSION_PATROL
		value = -100
	}
	ai_strategy = {
		type = naval_mission_threshold
		id = MISSION_STRIKE_FORCE
		value = 50
	}
}
